📰 General

Anthropic & OpenAI CEOs Criticize ICE Violence, Offer Support to Trump •

Following reports of violence involving Border Patrol agents in Minneapolis, the CEOs of Anthropic and OpenAI issued statements condemning the actions. Dario Amodei, Anthropic’s CEO, specifically referenced concerns about events observed in the preceding days. Both executives expressed support for former President Donald Trump’s stance on the situation. The statements represent a notable divergence from typical AI industry positions regarding law enforcement conduct.

🌍 World

Trump-Led Board to Gain Control of Gaza Governance and Aid Distribution •

The Board of Peace, established by former President Trump, is proposing to assume control over the governance and humanitarian aid distribution within the Gaza Strip. The plan outlines a significant expansion of the Board’s authority, granting it broad powers over the region’s future. The Board intends to oversee all aspects of Gaza’s administration and the provision of essential resources to its population. This initiative represents a substantial shift in international involvement within the conflict-affected territory.

🦅 US

Millions Still Battling Snow and Ice, New Winter Storm Threatens East Coast •

A significant winter storm has caused widespread disruption across the United States, with millions of residents currently working to clear roadways and recover from heavy snowfall. Thousands remain without power due to the storm’s impact on infrastructure, primarily caused by ice accumulation. The FOX Forecast Center predicts a new winter storm is developing off the East Coast, raising concerns about further travel disruptions and potential power outages. Officials are urging residents to remain vigilant and prepared for potential worsening conditions.

💰 Business

UPS Announces Massive Job Cuts and Facility Closures, Shifting Away from Amazon •

United Parcel Service (UPS) is planning to eliminate up to 30,000 operational roles and close 24 facilities by 2026. The company’s decision reflects a strategic shift towards prioritizing higher-margin shipments, moving away from significant business with Amazon. UPS cited the need to adapt to evolving market demands and improve profitability as key drivers for this restructuring. The company anticipates these changes will streamline operations and focus on more lucrative delivery services.

💻 Technology

Google Launches $7.99 AI Plus Plan, Now Available in 35 Countries •

Google has expanded the availability of its lower-priced Google AI Plus subscription to 35 countries, including the United States. The plan offers access to Google Gemini for $7.99 per month. This represents a significant price reduction compared to the previously available subscription tiers. The expansion allows a wider range of users to experience Google’s AI offerings. Google’s move aims to increase adoption of its AI services.

🎭 Entertainment

Dirty Dancing Sequel Announced: Original Star Returns After 40 Years •

Lionsgate Studios has announced a sequel to the 1987 classic Dirty Dancing, forty years after the original film’s release. Patrick Swayze, who starred in the original, will not be appearing in the new film. Neil Patrick Harris has been cast in the role of Johnny Castle’s son. The sequel will explore the legacy of the iconic dance film and the continuing story of its characters. Production is slated to begin later this year.

🏅 Sports

Mariners Legend Rick Rizzs Announces Retirement Following 2026 Season •

Rick Rizzs, the iconic voice of the Seattle Mariners for four decades, will retire from his broadcasting role after the 2026 season. The announcement comes after a remarkable career where Rizzs became synonymous with Mariners baseball, providing fans with a unique connection to the game. He has consistently delivered insightful commentary and a familiar voice for generations of Seattle fans. Rizzs’ departure marks the end of an era for the franchise and the Pacific Northwest.

🔬 Science

James Webb Telescope Reveals Stunning Final Moments of a Dying Star •

The James Webb Space Telescope has captured a breathtaking new image of the Helix Nebula, revealing the final stages of a star’s life. Previously observed by telescopes like Hubble and Spitzer, the image showcases the star’s expelled gases forming intricate columns of smoke-like material. These structures are the result of the star shedding its outer layers as it nears the end of its lifespan. Scientists are utilizing this detailed imagery to further understand stellar evolution and the processes involved in planetary nebula formation.

🩺 Health

Deadly Nipah Virus Spreads, Triggering Airport Screening Measures Worldwide •

The Nipah virus, currently causing outbreaks in India and across Asia, is presenting with symptoms including fever, headache, muscle aches, and respiratory difficulties. Health officials have identified the virus as having a high fatality rate, with no known cure currently available. Several airports have reinstated enhanced health screening procedures, mirroring those implemented during the COVID-19 pandemic, to monitor travelers. The World Health Organization (WHO) is monitoring the situation closely and advising vigilance regarding potential transmission.
